issues.issue: This is the Sewer Fund's only receipt, so it is most likely sewer user charges (charges for services/fees / sewer charges). The page doesn't say so, and the label prints 'Other', so 'other' with review is defensible. The same applies to detail[15].

The function is inferred from the Street Fund column, not printed in the row label. The 2026-11-12 FY2022 ruling says to give the function only when it is printed. This is defensible because the fund column is printed, but it is a judgment call. The same applies to detail[12].
The equity lines have no category field (equity[0] and equity[1]). The amounts are correct.
